manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the red block with the left arm, hand it to the right arm, and put it on the blue pad.

Task description: Use the left arm to grasp the upright red rectangular block on the left side of the table, hand it to the right arm, then have the right arm place it on the blue square mat on the right side of the table.

Success criteria: After handing the red block from the left arm to the right, the center of its bottom face is near the center of the blue mat's top surface and close to mat height. The right gripper is open and the block has been released.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping two offset sections along the red block's long axis with the two arms. Place pads near the middle of opposing side widths, away from corners and end edges, leaving approach and closure space for the other gripper.
- Open slightly wider than the grasped block section and confirm in side view that the fingers straddle the red block. During handoff, gradually remove left support only after the right gripper reliably bears the load to prevent dropping.
- During transport or pose adjustment, leave clearance for the lower end of the red block to pass above objects on the table. Watch especially for the can on the left and watering-can spout on the right to avoid sweeping into them.
- Keep the red block upright when placing it on the mat if possible. Let its bottom lie flat and be supported before releasing the right gripper to reduce tipping of the long narrow block.
